services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Explore our curated menu of premium spa, beauty, and wellness treatments at LYA Spa & Salon.

items.swedishMassageDesc: Indulge in a timeless classic at LYA Spa & Salon. Our Swedish Massage utilizes masterful, flowing strokes and gentle kneading to dissolve muscle tension.
items.tunisianHammamDesc: Experience an authentic Tunisian hammam ritual at LYA. Enjoy a traditional steam cleanse, gentle exfoliation, and rich nourishing rituals.
items.deepTissueDesc: For those seeking powerful relief from chronic pain and muscle tightness, our Deep Tissue Massage is the definitive solution.
items.footMassageDesc: Revitalize your entire being from the ground up with our specialized Foot Massage. This ancient reflexology-based treatment targets key pressure points.
items.classicLashDesc: Our Classic Lash Extension service meticulously applies one extension to one natural lash, creating a timeless, elegant enhancement.
items.volumeLashDesc: For maximum drama and fullness, our Volume Lash Extensions involve applying multiple lightweight fans to each natural lash.
items.lashLiftDesc: Elevate your natural beauty with a Lash Lift, the ultimate low-maintenance lash solution. This semi-permanent treatment curls your natural lashes from the root.
items.hydraFacialDesc: Experience the ultimate skin detox with our Hydra Facial. This multi-step treatment cleanses, exfoliates, extracts impurities, and hydrates the skin.
items.signatureFacialDesc: Indulge in our exclusive, bespoke facial curated by our senior therapist. This luxurious treatment is customized to your unique skin needs.
items.underarmLaserDesc: Embrace the freedom of flawlessly smooth underarms with our advanced laser hair removal. Using state-of-the-art technology, we provide a safe and permanent solution.
items.fullLegLaserDesc: Experience the luxury of permanently smooth, hair-free legs. Our Full Leg Laser treatment covers both legs from ankle to thigh.
items.koreanManicureDesc: An indulgent, multi-step manicure inspired by Korean beauty rituals. Includes deep exfoliation, a nourishing mask, extensive massage, and meticulous cuticle work.
items.koreanPedicureDesc: The ultimate pampering for your feet. This premium pedicure uses advanced Korean skincare techniques, including multi-level exfoliation and hydrating masks.
items.gelPolishDesc: Enjoy weeks of flawless, chip-free colour with our premium Gel Polish service. We offer a vast selection of shades, all expertly applied and cured.
items.womenHairDesc: Transform your look with a bespoke Women's Hair Cut from our master stylists in Riyadh. Following a thorough consultation, we will craft a style that perfectly complements your face shape.
items.menHairDesc: Experience the art of modern barbering with our expert Men's Hair Cut. Our stylists are skilled in both classic and contemporary techniques.
items.hairSpaDesc: Indulge in a luxurious hair spa treatment designed to nourish, hydrate, and rejuvenate your hair using premium organic products.
